refresh_seconds.label: Refresh interval
refresh_seconds.description: Seconds between calendar lookups. The countdown itself ticks every second.

max_title_length.label: Max title length
max_title_length.description: Event titles longer than this are truncated in the bar.

imminent_minutes.label: Imminent threshold
imminent_minutes.description: Minutes before the start at which the widget turns urgent.

hide_when_empty.label: Hide when nothing is scheduled
hide_when_empty.description: Remove the widget from the bar when there is no upcoming event.

notify_at_start.label: Notify about meetings
notify_at_start.description: Send one notification per meeting, shortly before it starts.

calendar_app.label: Calendar app
calendar_app.description: Command used to open the calendar when there is no meeting to join.

join_window_minutes.label: Join window
join_window_minutes.description: Clicking the widget joins the meeting when it starts within this many minutes; otherwise it opens the agenda.

panel_font_size.label: Agenda text size
panel_font_size.description: Base font size in the agenda panel. Titles and day headers scale with it.

notify_minutes_before.label: Notify before a meeting
notify_minutes_before.description: Minutes of warning before a meeting starts. 0 notifies as it begins.

tooltip.hint: Left click: join / open calendar · Right click: refresh

agenda.title: Agenda
agenda.stale: Teams is not running; showing cached data
